title: Home guide: the melting race
subject: Science
unit: Spring 1: States of matter (Marvellous Medicine and How Far Can Sound Travel?)
source: Written for science/y4 lesson 2 (Home practical guide and safety card: melting race (portal worksheet; no cooker, no hot water))
intro: Read it all first, then do it with an adult nearby.

practical.aim: Find out which solid melts first in the same warm place.
equipment: Small pieces of butter, chocolate and ice
safety: No cooker and no hot water
An adult knows what you are doing and stays nearby
Clear a space; tidy up and wash your hands afterwards
method: Put each piece on its own saucer.
Put all three saucers in the same warm place.
